profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Software engineering professional with extensive experience in software design and development in both start-up and large company environments.  Proven ability to design applications that meet customer requirements and deliver those applications on time.  Detail-oriented self-starter with strong problem-solving skills

Specialties: 
Languages: Java (Swing, AWT, Sockets, Threads), C++, C, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, JQuery
Technologies: MFC, COM, OOD, XML, Localization
Tools: Eclipse, Visual Studio, CVS, Visual SourceSafe, Subversion, Perforce, TestTrack Pro, Team Foundation Server

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Development and enhancement of features in Skillsoft's Course Players presenting interactive course content. The Skillsoft Course Player (SCP) provides a desktop solution using Java, JavaScript, HTML and XML. The Rich Internet Application Course Player (RIA) provides a desktop and mobile (Tablets/Smartphone’s) solution using JavaScript, HTML5, XML, JQuery and CSS3. 

Applied WAI-ARIA standards to RIA content meeting 508/WCAG compliance.

positions.title: Consulting Engineer
positions.description:
Nuance acquired eCopy October 2009.

Supported the transition of software development from the Nuance development center in Nashua, NH to Budapest, Hungary.

positions.title: Consulting Engineer
positions.description:
Played a lead role in the development of eCopy products including:

Researched new technologies from Canon Inc. (MEAP) to prototype ShareScan, a client-server application which provided users access to their corporate applications from an embedded application running in Canon’s multifunction peripheral devices (MFPs). This was a significant step forward for the company, enabling the replacement of existing hardware solutions with a complete software solution that significantly increased revenues.

Developed the commercial version of the ShareScan client, an embedded Java application for Canon MFPs.

Researched new technologies from Ricoh (SDK/J) and developed the commercial version of the ShareScan client, an embedded Java application for Ricoh MFPs.

patents.title: Method of and system for dynamically controlling during run time a multifunction peripheral touch panel user interface from an external remote network-connected computer.
